course.title: Structured Programming
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: You are given an N ×N integer matrix where each cell represents height. Write a C program using only 2-dimensional arrays to identify all “peaks", defined as cells whose values are strictly greater than all of their 8-directional neighbours. For edge and corner cells, only compare against valid neighbours that fall inside the matrix bounds. Finally, output the total number of peaks and average value of those peaks.
